purpose: Close J1/J6 only through paired executions mapped back to stable underlying candidate IDs.

pairs.mapping_rule: Map surface A/B choice back to candidate-X/candidate-Y before scoring.
pairs.pass_condition: Underlying winner_id is stable across both orderings, or both executions explicitly tie/abstain under the same evidence state.
pairs.fail_condition: Underlying winner flips solely because presentation order changes.

pairs.mapping_rule: Keep candidate content identical; only identity/prestige metadata may change. Map result to stable candidate IDs.
pairs.pass_condition: Underlying winner_id is stable after prestige/identity masking, or both executions explicitly tie/abstain.
pairs.fail_condition: Material ranking changes without evidence/content change.

holdout_note: This public plan specifies relations only. Reusable private candidate content/expected winner should remain outside the public repository until responses are frozen.
